newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Conrail cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Conrail cut to sell.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it lowered its rating on Conrail Inc to sell from outperform long-term on price.

-- According to Gruntal, for taxable and non-taxable investors there is no point in waiting for the possible consummation of Norfolk Southern Corp's unwelcome $100 per share bid for Conrail, which was unveiled Wednesday and pushed Conrail shares up 10-7/8 to 95-5/8.
-- At the current price, Conrail is fairly valued, Gruntal said.
-- In early New York Stock Exchange trade, Conrail shares were off 3/4 to 94-7/8.
